authorityCeiling.basis: Boundary: "A World remains a bounded projection, not a new source of truth." The World Emitter materializes an approved subgraph only; it executes approved emission and nothing beyond it, so its ceiling is execute.

Role quote: "Materializes an approved subgraph into reports, APIs, software, interfaces, or physical instructions." Materializing an approved subgraph is execution of approved emission, bounded by the boundary quote: "A World remains a bounded projection, not a new source of truth."

capabilityFamilies.basis: Role quote: "Materializes an approved subgraph into reports, APIs, software, interfaces, or physical instructions."

lifecycleStages.basis: Section 3.3 defines lifecycleMask as workflow stage and completion state but names no stages. The paper assigns no lifecycle stages to World Emitter.

memoryPlanes.basis: The paper assigns no memory planes to World Emitter. Materialization reads an approved subgraph; no memory plane is named for that function.

outputClasses.basis: Role quote: "Materializes an approved subgraph into reports, APIs, software, interfaces, or physical instructions." Reports, software, and interfaces are artifacts; APIs are named literally; the emission itself is world-emission. Note: "physical instructions" is NOT mapped to the Section 3.3 physical-commands class, because the paper does not equate the two terms.

permittedRoutes.basis: The paper defines routeMask semantics in Sections 3.2 and 3.3 but names no per-organ routes for World Emitter.

paperBoundary: A World remains a bounded projection, not a new source of truth.
paperRole: Materializes an approved subgraph into reports, APIs, software, interfaces, or physical instructions.
paperSource: N-Cell position paper, Section 4 mapping table, https://ncell-position-paper.pages.dev/, accessed 2026-11-14.
